blockers.verbatim_goal: Leave the repository's own gate battery green on every file this task touches: `bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh` reporting no FAIL that names a file inside this task's touched set.
blockers.what_was_tried: Ran the full `bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh` twice (once before any ledger row, once after every Phase 3 edit). Both runs report exactly one FAIL: C16's env_linter batch, `ZTimeSubstitutionBridge.lean:89:1: error: @FormalSystem.Metalogic.wordOf 1 unused argument: argument 2: [F.IsRegular]`, 1 error in 18945 declarations. Both candidate repairs were evaluated against their governing contracts: the in-source `@[nolint unusedArguments]` plus an entry in scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt (the route the gate's own remediation text recommends), and dropping the unused `[F.IsRegular]` instance binder from wordOf.
blockers.why_it_failed: Neither repair is available to this dispatch unilaterally. The allowlist route is inadmissible under scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt's own ADMISSION BAR, which requires a reason saying why THIS declaration cannot conform and states 'If the exemption is temporary, fix the declaration instead' -- wordOf can conform. The conforming route (dropping the binder) amends a signature pinned verbatim in the plan's `## Lean Challenge Statements`, and rules/plan-compliance.md's Statement Fidelity routes a pinned-statement amendment to escalation, not silent substitution: 'do not quietly edit the recorded Challenge to match what was implemented'. C16 is additionally named in no phase's verification criteria, so no declared criterion settles which route the plan intends. Escalated as a blocking user_decision with a recommendation rather than resolved; Phase 3's own criteria are all green and the phase is committed.

user_decision.question: wordOf's pinned signature carries an [F.IsRegular] instance binder its body never consumes, which the C16 env_linter now reports as this task's only red finding; should the pinned Challenge statement be amended to drop it, or should the finding be suppressed in source?
options: Amend the plan's ## Lean Challenge Statements block and wordOf's declaration together, dropping the unused [F.IsRegular] binder in one change
Add an in-source @[nolint unusedArguments] on wordOf plus a matching permanent entry in scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt, keeping the pinned signature as written
Leave the C16 finding red and record it as accepted debt, since C16 is named in no phase's verification criteria
user_decision.recommended: Amend the plan's ## Lean Challenge Statements block and wordOf's declaration together, dropping the unused [F.IsRegular] binder in one change
user_decision.obligation: Clear the single FAIL in 'bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh' (C16 env_linter, ZTimeSubstitutionBridge.lean:89 wordOf unused argument) so Phase 4's closing battery can report that gate green on this task's own touched files, without either weakening a recorded Challenge statement silently or adding an allowlist entry that the allowlist's own ADMISSION BAR forbids.
